participant_a_prompt_text: Your partner will share a story about a time they felt too shy or intimidated to approach someone. Ask them what they think they could have done to feel more confident and discuss whether there are any common patterns or themes in your shared experiences of feeling timid.
participant_b_prompt_text: Tell your partner about a time when you felt too shy or intimidated to approach someone or ask for help. Explain the circumstances and how you wish you had handled it differently.
